BAR BENDING SCHEDULE (BBS) VERIFICATION | | A1 | Approved Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) available at fabrication site
Acceptance: Signed/stamped structural BBS available; copy provided to fabricator; no fabrication without approved BBS | IS 456:2000 Cl. 12 — Reinforcement detailing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | BBS matches latest structural drawing revision
Acceptance: BBS revision matches drawing revision; no amendments without design approval; mark drawing revision on BBS cover | IS 456:2000 Cl. 12 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | All bar marks identified per BBS
Acceptance: Each bar type (e.g., B1, B2, C1) clearly identified in BBS; fabricator uses same marks on bent bars | IS 456:2000 Cl. 12 — Bar identification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Cutting lengths verified including hook and bend allowances
Acceptance: Verify 5 bars per mark type: measure actual cutting length; compare to calculated length from BBS; tolerance ±25mm per IS 2502 | IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 — Bending and cutting practice | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. CUTTING | | B1 | Correct bar diameter selected per BBS
Acceptance: Verify bar diameter with vernier calipers; match to BBS specification for each mark; tolerance per IS 1786 Table 3 | IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Cutting length matches BBS — tolerance ±25mm
Acceptance: Measure 5 cut bars per mark: length = design length ±25mm; document min/max/mean lengths | IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Mechanical cutting only — no flame/torch cutting
Acceptance: Verify cutting method: hydraulic shear/guillotine acceptable; flame cutting or burning not acceptable; visually inspect cut end | IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.1 — Cutting methods | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Cut ends square and free from burrs
Acceptance: Cut end perpendicular to bar axis; no burrs or ragged edges; deburr if necessary; ends square within 2mm per bar length | IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. BENDING | | C1 | Minimum bending radius per IS 2502 — ≤20mm bars: 4d
Acceptance: Measure bend radius on 5 sample bars ≤20mm: radius ≥4d; use radius gauge or template; document actual radii | IS 2502:1963 Cl. 5.1; IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2 — Bend radii | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Minimum bending radius per IS 2502 — >20mm bars: 5d
Acceptance: Measure bend radius on 5 sample bars >20mm: radius ≥5d; use radius gauge or template; document actual radii | IS 2502:1963 Cl. 5.1 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Bending at ambient temperature — no heating permitted
Acceptance: Visually confirm bar not heated before bending; no burn marks or discoloration on bar surface; verify with site personnel | IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2; IS 2502:1963 Cl. 5 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Standard 90° hook dimensions — internal radius 4d + extension 12d
Acceptance: Measure 5 hooks: internal radius ≥4d; straight extension ≥12d from tangent point; tolerance ±5mm; document measurements | IS 2502:1963 Table 1; IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2.4.1 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | 135° hook dimensions — internal radius 2d + extension 10d
Acceptance: Measure 5 hooks: internal radius ≥2d; straight extension ≥10d; bend angle ~135° (±10°); tolerance ±5mm in extension | IS 2502:1963 Table 1; IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2.4.2 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C6 | Cranking angles and offsets per structural drawing
Acceptance: Verify 5 cranked bars: angle to nearest 5°; offset dimension ±10mm; height of crank ±5mm from drawing; use template if provided | IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2; structural design detailing | OK

CUTTING B1Correct bar diameter selected per BBS IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 (Wrong diameter is critical fabrication error) ✓ Verify bar diameter with vernier calipers; match to BBS specification for each mark; tolerance per IS 1786 Table 3 OKNCNAHOLD B2Cutting length matches BBS — tolerance ±25mm IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 (Length tolerance per IS 2502 practice) ✓ Measure 5 cut bars per mark: length = design length ±25mm; document min/max/mean lengths OKNCNAHOLD B3Mechanical cutting only — no flame/torch cutting IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.1 — Cutting methods (Torch cutting damages bar properties; mechanical shearing/guillotine required) ✓ Verify cutting method: hydraulic shear/guillotine acceptable; flame cutting or burning not acceptable; visually inspect cut end OKNCNAHOLD B4Cut ends square and free from burrs IS 2502:1963 Cl. 4 (Cut end quality affects bonding) ✓ Cut end perpendicular to bar axis; no burrs or ragged edges; deburr if necessary; ends square within 2mm per bar length OKNCNAHOLD C. BENDING C1Minimum bending radius per IS 2502 — ≤20mm bars: 4d IS 2502:1963 Cl. 5.1; IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2 — Bend radii (For bars ≤20mm diameter: internal bend radius minimum 4d (d=bar diameter)) ✓ Measure bend radius on 5 sample bars ≤20mm: radius ≥4d; use radius gauge or template; document actual radii OKNCNAHOLD C2Minimum bending radius per IS 2502 — >20mm bars: 5d IS 2502:1963 Cl. 5.1 (For bars >20mm diameter: internal bend radius minimum 5d) ✓ Measure bend radius on 5 sample bars >20mm: radius ≥5d; use radius gauge or template; document actual radii OKNCNAHOLD C3Bending at ambient temperature — no heating permitted IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2; IS 2502:1963 Cl. 5 (Cold bending only; heating alters bar properties) ✓ Visually confirm bar not heated before bending; no burn marks or discoloration on bar surface; verify with site personnel OKNCNAHOLD C4Standard 90° hook dimensions — internal radius 4d + extension 12d IS 2502:1963 Table 1; IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2.4.1 (Standard hook: 4d radius + 12d extension for ≤20mm bars (Fe 500 TMT)) ✓ Measure 5 hooks: internal radius ≥4d; straight extension ≥12d from tangent point; tolerance ±5mm; document measurements OKNCNAHOLD C5135° hook dimensions — internal radius 2d + extension 10d IS 2502:1963 Table 1; IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2.4.2 (Inclined hook (135°): 2d radius + 10d extension (typical end hooks for cantilever slabs)) ✓ Measure 5 hooks: internal radius ≥2d; straight extension ≥10d; bend angle ~135° (±10°); tolerance ±5mm in extension OKNCNAHOLD C6Cranking angles and offsets per structural drawing IS 456:2000 Cl. 12.2; structural design detailing (Cranks and offsets as shown in drawing; angle and dimension critical for fit) ✓ Verify 5 cranked bars: angle to nearest 5°; offset dimension ±10mm; height of crank ±5mm
